decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The windows folding windows along the front and side elevations of the building shall be closed  between the hours of 6pm and 10am the following day.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the information shown on the submitted plans, a scheme to enable wheelchair access to the restaurant shall be constructed in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be submitted within 3 months of the date of this planning permission and completed within 6 months of the approval of such submitted details.

Condition : 5 - The application for the retention of a new shop front including the rentention of new windows, as shown on drawing numbers W4 5NB/actl-15, W4 5NB/actl-16 & W4 5NB/actl-17, received on 26th June 2006, is recommended for approval as the proposed development satisfactorily complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 All New Development, ENV-B.1.8 Disabled Access, S.4.2 Shop Front Design, and Supplementary Planning Guidance. In this regard the proposed development would not adversely affect the visual quality of the building or the character of the street scene and it would maintain the amenity of surrounding properties and commercial area.
description: Retention of shop front and new windows to restaurant.
